observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black console with a distinctive curved top and a vertical seam, placed on a wooden surface. A white and black controller is in front of it.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a front-facing angle, with a white top and a black horizontal line across the middle. The controller is in front, and the background is the same framed picture.
The console has a glossy finish with reflections visible on the surface.
The controller has a standard DualSense design with analog sticks, D-pad, and action buttons.
The background includes a framed picture with a music player interface showing 'Love Yourz' by J. Cole.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'ABIODUN JAMES' are overlaid on both photos.
No visible branding or model numbers are readable on the console or controller in either photo.

claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: The console appears clean and free of visible damage, but there is no proof of internal condition, functionality, or software status. The controller is present but no proof of it working.
